_what: The residue countdown for the two-harness window (RUN_ORDER amendment 2026-09-02 (7), items (ii) and (iv)). These are the OLD probe harness's remaining size. HarnessResidueTests derives the same three numbers from the source tree every run and fails unless they match exactly: growth is a failing test, and a shrink that is not recorded here is one too. W7 is not complete while these are above zero.
_how: probeFiles = *Probe*.cs under src/housecarl-generator (recursive, bin/obj excluded). probeLines = their total lines. ciAllRows = the ("name", XProbe.RunGuard) rows in CiAll.cs, which is what ci-all runs and what its summary's N/N reports.
_lowered_by: A conversion PR: it deletes the probe, adds the tests, and lowers these in the same commit.
